Search your notes, restore a deck's deleted cards all at once, and see today's reviews on the Study Desk. Existing study behavior, FSRS scheduling, data lifecycle rules, suggested cards, file import, and the backup format are unchanged.

- Notes: a *Search notes* field above the library shows only the notes whose title or text contains what you type, ignoring capitals (accented letters too). The list keeps its order, most recently edited first. *Clear*, or Escape, brings back every note. Deleted notes aren't searched, and searching isn't remembered when you leave.
- Deleted cards: when a deck has two or more deleted cards, *Restore all* brings every one of them back at once, after asking. Like restoring one card, it keeps each card's schedule and review history exactly as they were, and archived decks and the Sample deck are refused.
- Study Desk: a quiet line under the intro counts today's reviews and the different cards they were for, such as *Today: 12 reviews · 9 cards*, or *No reviews yet today*. "Today" starts at midnight on your computer's clock, and every rating made today counts, including ones of cards you've since deleted. There are no streaks, scores, or percentages.

Windows x64 installers:

- Synapse_0.6.0_x64_en-US.msi
- Synapse_0.6.0_x64-setup.exe

The installers are unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run. They were built on GitHub's Windows machines by the Release workflow, after its tests passed.
